name: Library
summary: Books you own, chapter by chapter, with the words you mark in them and summaries beside each chapter. Its book is the Reading list's, with every field it has.

book.description: A book you own: one edition. Its chapters and summaries are records in its folder.

at.description: Where you stopped: the chapter and its paragraph.

chapter.description: A chapter or part of a book, as the book divides it. Its text is the body.

part.description: The part it sits in, itself a chapter record.

quote.description: Words you marked in a book, with your note. It says where they are, so they can be found again.

from.description: The chapter the words are in.

block.description: The paragraph's number in the chapter.

before.description: A few words just before, to find the place again.

used_in.description: The addresses of the pieces it went into.

summary.description: A summary of a chapter, a part or a whole book, beside it, never inside it. It says who wrote it.
